title: Grateful Dead Live at Polo Field, Golden Gate Park on 1969-05-07
lineage: SBD > MR > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Good audience‑sourced recording captures a tight May 7 1969 Golden Gate Park set with standout Dark Star, Jerry‑led Good Lovin', and adventurous jams like Uncle and Other One.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its energetic, creative jams and a surprisingly tight band performance, highlighted by a superb Dark Star, an unusual Good Lovin' featuring Jerry on lead vocals, and long improvisations on Uncle, Other One and Smokestack Lightning. The audience recording is decent for the era – an “A‑grade” sound that needs a bit of EQ and suffers occasional cut‑outs, but remains listenable. Overall the performance outweighs the modest technical limitations.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) and numerous positive comments about the music outweigh the few mentions of recording flaws, leading to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is an “A‑grade” for a 1969 outdoor audience tape – not as sharp as later soundboard releases, some EQ needed, occasional instrumental cut‑out and minor drop‑outs but overall clear enough to enjoy.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set breaks the typical DS‑SS‑11‑LL pattern of the era, delivering a surprise‑filled flow with long improvisational jams, a quirky Good Lovin' vocal showcase and seamless transitions into Dark Star.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Leads vocals on Good Lovin', plays petal steel, acoustic and electric guitar; noted for tight playing and creative solos.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s Turn On Your Love Light praised as a classic 69 performance.
